WITH

hotels_with_pools AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT h."id", h."name", c."name" AS city_name
    FROM "hotel" h
    JOIN "city" c ON h."city_id" = c."id"
    JOIN "roomtype" rt ON h."id" = rt."hotel_id"
    JOIN "featureinroom" fir ON rt."id" = fir."roomtype_id"
    JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON fir."leisurefeature_id" = lf."id"
    WHERE c."name" ILIKE '%New York%'
      AND LOWER(lf."feature") LIKE '%swimming pool%'
),


hotels_with_hot_tubs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT h."id", h."name", c."name" AS city_name
    FROM "hotel" h
    JOIN "city" c ON h."city_id" = c."id"
    JOIN "roomtype" rt ON h."id" = rt."hotel_id"
    JOIN "featureinroom" fir ON rt."id" = fir."roomtype_id"
    JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON fir."leisurefeature_id" = lf."id"
    WHERE c."name" ILIKE '%New York%'
      AND LOWER(lf."feature") LIKE '%hot tub%'
)

SELECT

    GROUP BY

),

    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total
    FROM

WHERE
